Directions

Traveling north or south on Interstate 95, take Exit 109. Yield right onto Western Avenue (Route 17/202) and travel straight until you reach the rotary. Take the second exit off the rotary. Travel across Memorial Bridge that spans the Kennebec River; at the end of the bridge you will come to another rotary bear right onto Stone Street (Route 9/17). Travel up Stone Street (Route 9) stay in right lane to first set of lights, go straight to the 4-way intersection with second traffic light stay straight on Stone Street (Route 9), travel approximately 5/10th of a mile to the third traffic light, turn right into the AMHI Complex (the brick buildings on the right). Take the first driveway on your right. Parking is available in the large parking lot on the right, just beyond the Deering Building.

We are located on the 1st floor and you can enter on the end of the building by the granite wall.

decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 1 heading sits at a level the page never opens — "Staff Contact" is an h4 with no h3 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Write the email addresses the same way
decisions.why: 2 addresses are shown in whatever case it was typed in. The house form capitalises each name and leaves a middle initial in lower case — Kobi.L.Chase@maine.gov → Kobi.l.Chase@maine.gov. Only the first letter of each part changes, so a name that spells itself LaBreck keeps doing so.

decisions.label: Give the sub-headings their rule
decisions.why: 1 sub-heading is plain bold text. The design has a treatment for them — a teal rule down the left and a line across — and it had never been used on any page, because it needs a wrapper an author would have to know about.

decisions.label: Put the card titles on one level
decisions.why: 4 card titles are written at a level copied from an example rather than chosen — h5 on a page whose sections are h2. Only the number changes.

decisions.label: Make a loose address look like an address
decisions.why: 14 email addresses sit in the body of this page rather than in a contact block, drawn exactly like every other link — so the one that opens a mail window looks the same as the ones that go to web pages. The chip carries the same envelope the banner's contact link uses. The address itself does not change.

decisions.label: Let a short row of cards reach the page edge
decisions.why: 2 rows hold cards in columns that add up to less than the full twelve, so the grid stops short and the rest of the line is blank. The cards are narrower than they need to be, which makes everything inside them taller — and the page longer. Only the column widths change.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
decisions.why: It repeats the page title in picture form, which the new banner already does in type.

decisions.label: Match the heading treatments to the final levels
decisions.why: 1 heading was wearing the wrong treatment for its level — a section header round a sub-heading or the reverse — because the wrapper was chosen before the outline was finished.

decisions.label: Let a portrait photograph keep its shape
decisions.why: 10 card pictures are taller than they are wide — headshots, mostly — and every card image is cropped to 16:9, so most of the person is thrown away to make a landscape strip. Measured from the files: these are 500x667 rendered into 293x165. Marked as portrait, the card gives them a shape they fit and the picture runs up the card instead. The file does not change.

decisions.label: Add a contents list (3 sections)
decisions.why: Built from the section headings already on the page. Below three sections a list is not a route.
